```{r cars}

library(sf)
library(dplyr)

# ---- 1. Read the shapefile ----
gdf <- st_read("Mexico_mun_layer_simplified/Mexico_mun_layer_simplified.shp",
               options = "ENCODING=LATIN1")# ---- 2. Check CRS (reproject only if needed) ----
st_crs(gdf)$epsg
if (st_crs(gdf)$epsg != 6372) {
  gdf <- st_transform(gdf, crs = 6372)
}

# ---- 3. Validate and fix geometries ----
sum(!st_is_valid(gdf))          # expect 15
gdf <- st_make_valid(gdf)
sum(!st_is_valid(gdf))          # expect 0

# ---- 4. Compute area in km^2 ----
gdf$area_km2 <- as.numeric(st_area(gdf)) / 1e6

# ---- 5. Standardize CVEGEO, build key frame ----
gdf$CVEGEO <- formatC(as.numeric(gdf$CVEGEO), width = 5, format = "d", flag = "0")
key_frame <- gdf %>% select(CVEGEO, NOMGEO, area_km2, geometry)

# ---- 6. Audit ----
nrow(key_frame)                                  # expect 2478
sum(duplicated(key_frame$CVEGEO))                # expect 0
sum(is.na(key_frame$CVEGEO))                     # expect 0
sum(nchar(key_frame$CVEGEO) != 5)                # expect 0
sum(key_frame$area_km2 <= 0 | is.na(key_frame$area_km2))  # expect 0

# Sanity extremes
key_frame %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% arrange(area_km2) %>% head(5)
key_frame %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% arrange(desc(area_km2)) %>% head(5)

# ---- 7. Cross-check against population file ----
pop <- read.csv("cs_municipal_2025_popweighted.csv") %>%
  mutate(CVEGEO = formatC(CVEGEO, width = 5, format = "d", flag = "0"))

setdiff(pop$CVEGEO, key_frame$CVEGEO)   # expect the 8 placeholder codes ending 998/999
setdiff(key_frame$CVEGEO, pop$CVEGEO)   # expect empty

# ---- 8. Cross-check against treated61 ----
treated <- read.csv("treated61-2.csv") %>%
  mutate(CVEGEO = formatC(CVEGEO, width = 5, format = "d", flag = "0"))

nrow(treated)                                     # expect 61
setdiff(treated$CVEGEO, key_frame$CVEGEO)         # expect empty — all 61 present

table(treated$gov_inclusion_code)                 # confirm 25 "strategic" / 36 criteria-based split

# ---- 9. Save ----
st_write(key_frame, "key_frame.gpkg", delete_dsn = TRUE)
write.csv(st_drop_geometry(key_frame), "key_frame.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```


```{r}

# ---- Load criteria 1-2 source ----
criteria_raw <- readxl::read_excel("cs_municipal_2025.xlsx")

# ---- Standardize CVEGEO ----
criteria_raw <- criteria_raw %>%
  mutate(CVEGEO = formatC(cve_mun_completa, width = 5, format = "d", flag = "0"))

# ---- Collapse daily averages to 2025 annual totals ----
# NOTE: confirm with team whether *365 is the right conversion, or if there's
# a documented number of reporting days for 2025 to use instead
criteria_12 <- criteria_raw %>%
  mutate(
    homicidios_total = homicidio_doloso_prom_diario * 365,
    robos_total       = robo_veh_violencia_prom_diario * 365
  ) %>%
  select(CVEGEO, municipio, homicidios_total, robos_total)

# ---- Join onto the key frame ----
criteria_12_full <- key_frame %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(CVEGEO, NOMGEO, area_km2) %>%
  left_join(criteria_12, by = "CVEGEO")

# ---- Audit ----
nrow(criteria_12_full)                                   # should be 2478
sum(is.na(criteria_12_full$homicidios_total))             # count missing
sum(is.na(criteria_12_full$robos_total))                  # count missing
sum(duplicated(criteria_12_full$CVEGEO))                  # should be 0

# orphans: in criteria file but not in key frame
setdiff(criteria_12$CVEGEO, key_frame$CVEGEO)

# Sanity extremes
criteria_12_full %>% arrange(desc(homicidios_total)) %>% head(5) %>% select(CVEGEO, NOMGEO, homicidios_total)
criteria_12_full %>% arrange(desc(robos_total)) %>% head(5) %>% select(CVEGEO, NOMGEO, robos_total)

# ---- Save ----
write.csv(criteria_12_full, "criteria_12_cross_section.csv", row.names = FALSE)


```
```{r}

# ---- Load perceived insecurity (population-weighted, Cabinet's preferred measure) ----
# ---- Select perception-related columns (matching Ethan's approach) ----
insecurity_df <- pop %>%
  select(
    CVEGEO,
    pct_inseguro_municipio,
    n_inseguro_popw,
    rank_n_inseguro_popw,
    n_muestra_percepcion,
    pobtot_2020,
    p_18ymas_2020
  )

# ---- Join onto your existing criteria_12_full ----
municipality_merged <- criteria_12_full %>%
  left_join(insecurity_df, by = "CVEGEO")

head(municipality_merged)   # inspect before narrowing down

# ---- Narrow to final table, keeping only the Cabinet's preferred measure ----
final_key_df <- municipality_merged %>%
  select(
    CVEGEO,
    NOMGEO,
    homicidios_total,
    robos_total,
    n_inseguro_popw
  )

head(final_key_df)

# ---- Audit ----
nrow(final_key_df)                          # should be 2478
sum(is.na(final_key_df$n_inseguro_popw))    # check coverage
sum(duplicated(final_key_df$CVEGEO))        # should be 0

# ---- Save ----
write.csv(final_key_df, "final_key_df.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
